newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cebu Shipyard sets cash, stock dividends.
newsitem.headline: Cebu Shipyard sets cash, stock dividends.

text.p: Cebu Shipyard & Engineering Works Inc said on Monday its board had declared a five percent cash dividend and a 10 percent stock dividend.
The cash dividend will be given to shareholders as of July 11.
The payment date is on August 8.
The record date for the stock dividend is yet to be fixed by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
"The said stock dividend will be used to comply with subscription and payment requirements for the increase in capital stock from 295 million pesos to 375 million," it added.
Cebu Shipyard, a subsidiary of Keppel Group, will change its name to Keppel Cebu shipyard and Engineering Inc.
